    {"field": "Polymer system Notes", "value": "PEC was donated by a Japanese company. PEC was dissolved in acetonitrile with Li salts. The ratio of Li+ to the EC monomer unit of PEC was chosen as 5 ~ 80 mol% ([Li+]/[EC] = 1/20 ~ 1/1.25). The sample film was dried in a vacuum at 60°C for 24 h and then introduced into a glove box filled with dry Ar gas."},
